entries.2c8580dc1505b158: This is the company group's core business and its only reportable segment, renting and selling construction machinery and temporary construction materials in Japan and overseas. In Japan, the company and other group companies such as Kanki Co., Ltd., Central Co., Ltd., Nishiken Co., Ltd. and Unite Co., Ltd. rent and sell construction machinery. Some group companies design, sell and rent temporary unit houses, and rent and sell special machinery for ground improvement and shield tunneling methods, measuring instruments and road construction machinery. Overseas, it has bases in Australia, China, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥190,225 million, accounting for the largest part of consolidated revenue.
